mission_10: CTE 1 (revenue): Filter to `status = 'completed'` and `order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'`. Use `SUM(total_amount) AS revenue` and `GROUP BY customer_id`.
CTE 2 (leaderboard): Use `RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk` and `DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS drnk` to add ranking columns.
Final SELECT: pull all four columns from the leaderboard CTE, sort by `revenue DESC`, and add `LIMIT 10` to return only the top 10.
